text: This chapter begins Spread Clusters: 6 Voicing Types across 6 Cycles in C Major. Each voicing/cycle combination is governed by an Intervallic/Functional voice-leading grid. Drop 2 & 4 on Cycle 7 of C Melodic Minor exhibits three common-tone voices with a single 4th-interval move on degree 3 (functional 3 → 7). 4-way close on Cycle 5 shows all four voices moving by step with characteristic contrary-motion exchanges. Drop 2 Cycle 5 shows symmetrical contrary-motion pairs (2 ↔ 7 and 3 ↔ 1). Cycle 3 4-way close demonstrates cascading stepwise descent (functional 3 → 2 → 1 → 7).
